text:
maria: FYI — after pushing nvidia-driver 525 to dev and canary fleets we started seeing boot failures in us-west-1 GPU nodes. DKMS build failing during provisioning.
ops-bot: node-gpu-11 transitioned to NotReady (Kubelet) 1893456792
cheng: Seeing node kubelet errors referencing nvidia modules: 'modprobe: FATAL: Module nvidia_uvm not found in directory /lib/modules/5.15.0-101-generic'
samir: Can we cordon/drain the affected nodes and roll them back to 515? We should pause the rollout.
julia: Agreed. Marking canary failed. I'll stop the batch rollout and add a filter for kernel version mismatch.
devon: DKMS logs show header mismatch and build errors — common pattern is missing linux-headers for the running kernel. Example from /var/lib/dkms/nvidia/525/build/make.log:
```
DKMS make.log for nvidia-525-525.89.05 for kernel 5.15.0-101-generic (x86_64)
make: Entering directory '/usr/src/linux-headers-5.15.0-101-generic'
make[1]: *** No rule to make target 'modules'.  Stop.
ERROR: Cannot locate kernel sources of version 5.15.0-101-generic
``` 
cheng: Some nodes were provisioned with custom kernels (we patched a kmod early) — autoscaler probably pulled newer AMIs without matching headers.
maria: Immediate action: 1) Pause rollout (julia) 2) Cordon/drain impacted nodes (samir) 3) Re-image or install headers on the node pool; if can't fix quickly revert to 515 images (devon)
samir: I'll cordon/drain the 8 nodes in us-west-1a now and move workloads. Disabling autoscaler for the ASG.
samir: Done — nodes cordoned and drained 1893456810 :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: rollback job started for fleet:gpu-us-west-1a -> reverting to nvidia-driver 515 (ticket INF-2782) 1893456815
julia: Also seeing NCCL timeout warnings on a subset in eu-central-1, probably unrelated but we should watch. Training jobs got repeated NCCL errors after the upgrade.
devon: For longer-term fix we should: - ensure AMI baking installs exact linux-headers for kernel - add dkms status check in health probe - add a canary step that reboots nodes post-driver-install before marking success
maria: Agreed. I'll open an RFC for AMI process + rollout gating. For now we'll finish rollback and re-run canary on a small isolated AZ.
ops-bot: rollback job completed 1893456840
maria: Thanks everyone — follow-up in #eng-infra postmortem doc. I'll assign owners for the RFC and AMI change.
